transcript: Remember, there is nothing in this world that can hurt you as much as your thoughts. Not the past, not other people, not even the circumstances you are facing right now. A single thought, repeated quietly, can tighten the body, steal your breath, and make a peaceful moment feel like danger. But remember this as well, there is nothing in this world that can heal you as much as your thoughts. A gentle thought can soften the nervous system. A kind thought can bring the body back into safety. A truthful thought can release years of tension without changing anything on the outside. You do not need to fight your mind, you only need to guide it. What you think becomes what you feel. What you feel becomes how you live. So choose your thoughts carefully because they are not just passing ideas, they are either wounds or they are medicine. If this spoke to you and you're tired of living inside noisy thoughts, the way back to stillness was written for you. You can find it in the link on my profile. It's not about forcing peace or fixing yourself, it's about gently guiding the mind back to where the body can finally rest.
